database_summary: Soccer match and roster dataset (SQLite) with tables for players, player attributes (time-stamped skill ratings), teams, team attributes (time-stamped tactical/profile), leagues/countries, and matches (events with lineups, statistics and betting odds). Mix of static entities (Player, Team, League, Country), temporal attribute snapshots (Player_Attributes, Team_Attributes) and match-event records (Match).

accepted.name: player_latest_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  player_api_id,
  date,
  overall_rating,
  potential,
  preferred_foot,
  attacking_work_rate,
  defensive_work_rate,
  crossing,
  finishing,
  heading_accuracy,
  short_passing,
  volleys,
  dribbling,
  curve,
  free_kick_accuracy,
  long_passing,
  ball_control,
  acceleration,
  sprint_speed,
  agility,
  reactions,
  balance,
  shot_power,
  jumping,
  stamina,
  strength,
  long_shots,
  aggression,
  interceptions,
  positioning,
  vision,
  penalties,
  marking,
  standing_tackle,
  sliding_tackle,
  gk_diving,
  gk_handling,
  gk_kicking,
  gk_positioning,
  gk_reflexes,
  row_number AS latest_attr_rank
FROM (
  SELECT
    pa.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC) AS row_number
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
) sub
WHERE row_number = 1
accepted.description: For each player (player_api_id), pick the most recent Player_Attributes snapshot by date and expose key ratings. Useful when you need a single canonical rating row per player for joins or aggregations (e.g., top players by overall_rating, join player attributes to matches or teams). | Use for: Find top-N players by overall_rating; Join latest player ratings to matches' lineups; Compute average attribute by team using latest player snapshots

accepted.name: match_lineup_players_unpivot
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS id,
  match_api_id AS match_api_id,
  'home' AS side,
  home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
  home_player_1 AS player_api_id,
  1 AS lineup_slot
FROM Match
WHERE home_player_1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL

accepted.description: Unpivot Match lineup columns (home_player_1..11 and away_player_1..11) into one row per match-player appearance. Exposes match id, match_api_id, team side (home/away), team_api_id, player_api_id and lineup_slot. Useful when counting appearances, joining player info to appearances, or analyzing player presence per match. | Use for: Count appearances by player or team; Join player attributes to each appearance; Filter matches where a specific player appeared

accepted.name: match_basic_outcomes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  match_api_id,
  country_id,
  league_id,
  season,
  stage,
  date,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  home_team_goal,
  away_team_goal,
  (home_team_goal - away_team_goal) AS goal_difference,
  CASE
    WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'home_win'
    WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 'draw'
    WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'away_win'
  END AS match_result,
  B365H,
  B365D,
  B365A
FROM Match
accepted.description: Normalized projection of Match with canonical outcome columns and basic betting odds selection. Computes match outcome (home_win/draw/away_win) and goal difference. Useful as a clean starting point for match-level modeling or aggregation. | Use for: Aggregate match outcomes by league or season; Train model predicting match_result from odds or team features; Compute goal difference statistics

accepted.name: player_identity
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  player_api_id,
  player_name,
  player_fifa_api_id,
  birthday,
  height,
  weight
FROM Player
accepted.description: Core player identity table (one row per Player) to join human-readable player_name and birthday onto other relations like appearances or attributes. Keeps both player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id for safe joins to either key. | Use for: Lookup player_name and birthday for appearances; Compute age at match date by joining to match date; Filter players by height/weight or name

accepted.name: match_team_odds
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  match_api_id,
  home_team_api_id,
  away_team_api_id,
  B365H,
  B365D,
  B365A,
  ( (CASE WHEN B365H IS NOT NULL THEN B365H ELSE NULL END) +
    (CASE WHEN BWH IS NOT NULL THEN BWH ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN IWH IS NOT NULL THEN IWH ELSE 0 END)
  ) / ( (CASE WHEN B365H IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN BWH IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN IWH IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) AS mean_home_odds
FROM Match
accepted.description: Aggregate betting-odds measures at the match level selecting available bookie odds into median-like measures. Provides B365 and a simple mean_odds across available bookmakers (ignores NULLs). Useful for studies comparing implied probabilities vs outcomes. | Use for: Compare odds to match outcomes; Filter matches by odds ranges; Use mean odds as feature in prediction
